title: Extra Weapons
description: My first mod, this adds extra weapons, tools, minerals, potions, enchantments, food and whatever else I think.
body:
![Extra Weapons: Rapier Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8759a5f73460765fbfebbfac43516bde48e5d442.png)
# What is this mod?
This mod is my first ever mod and will add many weapons, materials, potions, enchantments, and armor. It has some MC Dungeons enchantments, rapiers, daggers, scythes, steel, rubies, sapphire, transmutation wand, super tnt, dynamite, new arrows, and a bunch of stuff I came up with. It's currently a beta because the progression isn't 100% defined and is kinda jumbled up. If you were to download it in this state, I recommend to just play it in creative.
